fields.Name: EmbeddingGemma 2 (Local)
fields.Description: Google's EmbeddingGemma 2 text encoder (the 270M-parameter text path of the 740M-parameter multimodal model; the vision and audio encoders are not loaded), run locally via Transformers.js. 768-dimensional vectors that can be truncated to 512, 256 or 128 dimensions, an 8,192-token window, and strong multilingual retrieval.
fields.ModelSelectionInsights: Best for: multilingual content and long documents (up to 8,192 tokens). In MJ's retrieval benchmark it roughly tied all-mpnet-base-v2 on English queries and clearly beat every other local model on Spanish, German and French queries. Costs: about 0.9 GB of memory after loading (q8), up to about 2 GB after long inputs, and roughly 60-150 ms per short text on CPU, so saves that embed (agent notes, tags, queries) get slower. PowerRank sits below all-mpnet-base-v2, so it is not the default while that model is active: opt in by setting the MJ_DEFAULT_LOCAL_EMBEDDING_MODEL environment variable to 'EmbeddingGemma 2 (Local)' for every MJ process, then run the Re-embed Local Vectors action.
